FROM THE SHOPAfter years of speccing customer parts in PCPartPicker, the missing pieces became this site.

Why look for a PCPartPicker alternative?

PCPartPicker is the most recognized PC builder platform, but it has limitations. Users commonly cite these reasons for seeking alternatives:

  • Heavy ad load — PCPartPicker displays banner ads, sidebar ads, and promoted content that clutter the building experience
  • No hardware detection — you have to manually enter every part you own to get upgrade recommendations
  • No performance prediction — no way to see FPS estimates, bottleneck analysis, or game compatibility before buying
  • No budget-aware recommendations — it shows parts but doesn't prioritize upgrades by performance-per-dollar impact
  • No USED listings tracking — used and refurbished parts look the same as new ones in listings
  • Dated interface — core UI hasn't seen major changes in years; no dark mode
